subject: math

messages.content: Draw a right triangle ABC (AB=3, BC=4) with an inscribed circle. Label the vertices, the center of the circle, and the touch points. Use the quotes library for angle B = 90 deg. Anchor labels away from vertices.

Draw a normal distribution curve. Shade the area between mu-2sigma and mu+2sigma in light blue. Label mu, mu-sigma, mu+sigma, mu-2sigma, and mu+2sigma on the x-axis with 1.5x scaling. Ensure labels don't clump.
Draw a block on a 30-degree inclined plane. Draw force vectors for Gravity, Normal Force, and Friction. Use explicit anchors for labels to prevent them from covering the vectors.
